_comment: Pinned third-party tools bundled by scripts/fetch-tools.ps1. Every download is verified against these SHA-256 values; a mismatch aborts the build. To update: change version, url and hashes together (see docs/audit/RELEASE_AUDIT.md).

yt-dlp.source: SHA-256 equals the value in the release's SHA2-256SUMS (checked 2026-10-30)

ffmpeg.source: zip SHA-256 equals the value in the autobuild release's checksums.sha256 (checked 2026-10-30)
